_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — pages-installable-offline-and-mobile T02 (REQ-BQOM-001). Adds the optional shortName and themeColor properties to the shared `buildiq` register's Application schema. The run route's web app manifest (ApplicationsController::webManifest) reads both: short_name falls back to the app's name when shortName is empty, and theme_color is only sent for a six-digit hex colour. Edited in the Installable section of the app settings. Declarative schema metadata only; no other property or schema is touched.

shortName.title: Short name
shortName.description: The name under the app's icon on a phone's home screen once installed. Empty falls back to the app's name.

themeColor.title: Theme colour
themeColor.description: The colour of the installed app's title bar, as a six-digit hex colour such as #1f6feb. Empty leaves it to the browser.
